title: Setup: build spring-jdbc at both #37322 revisions and run the incrementer regression
description: Setup for case N05 of llm-dlc/loops/organic-java-merged-pr-links-n01-n05-brief.md, no claims. In the setup worktrees under ~/.cache/in-the-loop/merged-pr-links-n01-n05/worktrees, offline Gradle 9.8.0 (verified distribution, JDK 25 launcher, toolchains Temurin 17 and 25 only, no build cache or scan): builds spring-jdbc 7.0.10-SNAPSHOT and the modules it needs at the fix pin f96403da2a821f9b8281161847e32a1c4e35e470 and the parent pin eb9928f993fc650ba92a833ecfd28194c28afd3e, runs spring-jdbc's whole test task at each, keeps the jar, the MySQLMaxValueIncrementer class digest and the runtime and test runtime classpaths (project outputs copied to the setup's artifacts folder); then runs the fix's DataFieldMaxValueIncrementerTests on a copy of the parent (expected to fail), and removes the build trees.
